prompt_md: A traffic light cycles 40 seconds green, then 20 seconds red. You arrive at a random moment. On average, how many seconds do you wait (0 if it is green)?
prompt_short: 40 s green, 20 s red, random arrival. Average wait?
hint_md: How often do you wait at all?
explain_intuition_md: Two times out of three the light is green and you wait nothing. When it is red, you wait 10 seconds on average. 10 seconds is the average red-light wait, but you only hit red a third of the time.
